verdict.rationale: Gemini's documentation describes scheduled actions that run on daily, weekly or monthly schedules, such as a daily news digest, without the user starting each run. A proactive Daily Brief complements this. Together these cover the core of background automation. Missing for 10: event or condition-based triggers beyond time schedules, evidence that scheduled actions can take multi-step actions in connected apps, documentation of limits and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
